peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the job description of a CTO in LinkedIn?
peopleAlsoAsk.title: How to write a chief technology officer job description - LinkedIn Business
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The chief technology officer (CTO) develops and executes a robust IT strategy that aligns with the company's business objectives. They play a crucial role in driving technological innovation, shaping the digital roadmap and ensuring the successful implementation of technology initiatives within a company.
